items.name: Aiw3
items.tagline: The AIW3 Genesis Airdrop eligibility checker opened July 29, letting you verify whether your address qualifies based on

steps.title: Check Your Eligibility
steps.body: Visit the AIW3 airdrop page Connect your wallet Click “Verify Now” to view your status If your results appear incorrect, contact the AIW3 support team to request a manual review.

steps.title: Visit the AIW3 airdrop page
steps.body: Go to the AIW3 airdrop page and open the Airdrop tab. This is where your points, tasks, and ranking live.

steps.title: Connect your wallet and complete the tutorial
steps.body: Connect your wallet and then finish the onboarding tutorial on the Airdrop tab. Wallet binding is required for the snapshot, so do this before July 28.

steps.title: Check in daily
steps.body: Hit the check-in button every day. Rewards follow a 7-day cycle that climbs from 3 points on day 1 to 10 points on day 7, and missing a day does not reset your progress.

steps.title: Complete the community tasks
steps.body: Follow AIW3 on X, repost the featured campaign post, and join the AIW3 Telegram from the airdrop page. These one-time tasks pay 10 to 20 points each and take about two minutes.

steps.title: Make daily predictions
steps.body: Complete at least one prediction market entry per day for 20 points. Three predictions in a day pays 50 points, and inviting a friend who completes a prediction adds another 30. The prediction tasks reset daily, so they compound fast for consistent users.

steps.title: Trade on the platform
steps.body: You earn points for every 1,000 USDT in trading volume, plus milestone bonuses for consistent activity. You can grab USDT or SOL on Bybit , and if your funds sit on another chain, the widget below moves them over to Solana or BNB Chain in one transaction. Bridge funds Swap and bridge across 30+ chains without leaving this page. Fast routes, low fees. Bridge now Opens an interactive bridge widget Open the bridge in a new tab

steps.title: Publish AI strategies
steps.body: Create trading strategies and publish them to the Strategy Square. Strategy rewards are repeatable, so this suits users who want points without constant manual activity.

steps.title: Refer friends
steps.body: Share your referral link from the airdrop page. Referrals earn bonus points when invited users stay active, and they stack with the daily prediction invite task.

steps.title: Verify eligibility and claim
steps.body: Check the eligibility page from July 29, then claim your tokens when TGE goes live on August 3.

items.description: The AIW3 Genesis Airdrop eligibility checker opened July 29, letting you verify whether your address qualifies based on the July 28 snapshot. The checker displays snapshot eligibility, wallet verification status, and initial airdrop qualification.

items.name: Onchain Cc
items.tagline: The Onchain.cc team has not confirmed a native token or token airdrop. The platform’s Colosseum points system, sessions,

steps.title: Visit Onchain.cc
steps.body: Head to the Onchain.cc terminal and click “Start trading” on the landing page.

steps.title: Authenticate with Privy
steps.body: Sign in using one of the supported methods: Email — Privy creates an embedded non-custodial wallet for you. Google account — same flow as email, signed in with Gmail. External EVM wallet — connect MetaMask, Rabby, or another EVM wallet. Privy handles key management without holding your funds, so you keep custody throughout.

steps.title: Fund Your Wallets
steps.body: Open the wallet menu in the top right to see your Solana and EVM addresses. Ensure you have USDC, SOL, or ETH in your wallet. If you don’t have any, you can get them from Binance or swap and bridge funds directly using the widget below.

steps.title: Place Your First Trade
steps.body: Bridge funds Swap and bridge across 30+ chains without leaving this page. Fast routes, low fees. Bridge now Opens an interactive bridge widget Open the bridge in a new tab Three discovery paths feed into the same trading panel: Degen Feed (Trenches): Solana-only memecoin discovery with trending tokens and new launches. Contract address search: paste any token’s CA into the search bar to load its chart directly. Discover tab: filter by volume, market cap, or other criteria to find trending markets. Set your size, check the slippage estimate, and submit. Points accrue automatically based on your volume and any session multipliers active at the time.

steps.title: Climb the Colosseum Leaderboard
steps.body: Open the Colosseum tab to see the active season, current session timer, and any live Bonus Windows. Trading during a Bonus Window (typically 2x or 3x points for a few hours) is the fastest way to push your session rank.

steps.title: Earn Points from X Posts
steps.body: Onchain.cc runs a social scoring system that pays Colosseum points for posting about the platform on X. Tag the official @Onchaincc account so the AI scorer picks up your post. Quality, reach, and engagement determine the score on a 0–100 scale. Posts that share a real trade, include a screenshot of the terminal, or generate organic engagement score well. Spam and copy-paste content score near zero.

steps.title: Trade Perps on Hyperliquid Markets
steps.body: Switch to the perps tab to trade Hyperliquid’s 300+ markets from the same interface. Perp volume feeds into your Colosseum points the same way spot volume does, often with higher leverage and tighter spreads. Check funding rates before opening leveraged positions.

steps.title: Stack Sessions and Refer Friends
steps.body: Sessions reset weekly, each with its own leaderboard and USDC prize pool. Daily and weekly quests sit alongside the leaderboard, adding points and prize pool entries on top of your trading activity. You can also refer your friends to earn more points.

items.description: The Onchain.cc team has not confirmed a native token or token airdrop. The platform’s Colosseum points system, sessions, and seasonal leaderboards point toward a possible retroactive reward for early traders, similar to how other trading terminals have rewarded volume contributors before launching a token.

No positions get automatically liquidated, but once the deadline passes, there’s no way to retrieve anything.

items.name: Memebook
items.tagline: The Memebook airdrop is confirmed in principle: the project states that XP earned in the app today converts into $MBK ut

steps.title: Fund a Solana Wallet
steps.body: Install Phantom or Solflare and keep a small amount of SOL in it for network fees, tips, and any paid Pass tier. You can buy SOL on Bybit and withdraw straight to your Solana address.

steps.title: Connect Your Wallet to the Mint Page
steps.body: Open the Memebook mint page , connect the wallet you just funded, and sign the verification message. Use this same wallet throughout, since XP is tied to the address rather than a username.

steps.title: Verify Your X and Telegram Accounts
steps.body: Link both accounts on the mint page. Verification is required before minting and includes following the Memebook X account and joining the Telegram channel.

steps.title: Mint Your Memebook Pass
steps.body: Bronze is free and gets you into the app. Paid tiers raise your XP multiplier and daily limits, which compounds across every post. The Pass is soulbound, so it stays attached to the minting wallet and cannot be resold.

steps.title: Install the Android App
steps.body: Download Memebook from Google Play and sign in with the wallet holding your Pass. There is no iOS build, so an Android device is required for the in-app half of the campaign.

steps.title: Post and Engage Daily
steps.body: Publish photos or reels, like and comment on other creators, and complete the daily check-in. Spreading activity across days earns more than dumping the same volume into one session.

steps.title: Tip Creators and Share Your Invite Code
steps.body: Send SOL tips to posts you like, which is an on-chain action and counts toward your activity. Then share your invite link from the app to earn XP when someone you referred mints a Pass.

items.description: The Memebook airdrop is confirmed in principle: the project states that XP earned in the app today converts into $MBK utility at TGE. The allocation size and the XP-to-token rate have not been announced, so the sensible goal right now is banking XP rather than modelling a payout.

items.name: Voice
items.tagline: The $VOICE token and its token generation event are confirmed, with the TGE targeted for Q4 2026. VOICE ties $VOICE dist

steps.title: Visit the VOICE Social Camp
steps.body: Go to the VOICE Social Camp page. This is the pre-launch hub where quests, leaderboards, and CLOUT tracking live.

steps.title: Sign in with your X account
steps.body: Connect your X account, since most quests track posts, quotes, and mentions there. You can also continue with a Google account or a Solana wallet.

steps.title: Complete Core, Daily, and Burst tasks
steps.body: Clear the Core tasks first, then return for the Daily set. Burst tasks are shorter, higher-value entries announced in the VOICE Discord , so keep an eye there for drops.

steps.title: Vote in polls and Opinion Cup battles
steps.body: Cast votes on active polls and in Opinion Cup matchups. Each vote earns CLOUT, and the Cup runs creator battles with USDT prize pools on top.

steps.title: Join the Voice Pulse campaign
steps.body: Enter the Voice Pulse campaign for extra CLOUT and rewards. This round closes on September 1, so finish its tasks before the deadline.

steps.title: Complete the Layer3 VOICE campaign
steps.body: Head to the separate VOICE campaign on Layer3 , which carries an advertised $2,000 reward pool. Complete the listed quests to qualify for a share.

steps.title: Enter partner clusters
steps.body: Join the partner clusters inside Social Camp. These bundle quests from partner projects and carry their own USDT and NFT pools alongside CLOUT.

steps.title: Invite friends through FRENS
steps.body: Share your FRENS invite link. You earn a permanent 10% boost on the CLOUT your invitees generate, so early invites keep paying through the rest of the campaign.

items.description: The $VOICE token and its token generation event are confirmed, with the TGE targeted for Q4 2026. VOICE ties $VOICE distribution to activity: CLOUT earned in Social Camp hard-syncs to your profile, and the tiers list a base $VOICE airdrop allocation, whitelist access, NFT drops, and early access at the higher levels.

steps.title: Visit the DeepBook Waitlist
steps.body: Go to the DeepBook waitlist page and enter your email address to request early access to the new trading app.

steps.title: Verify Your Email
steps.body: Open the confirmation email DeepBook sends and click the verification link to lock in your spot on the list.

steps.title: Refer Traders to Move Up the Queue
steps.body: Share your referral link with other traders. Each signup through your link moves you higher in the queue, since access opens in waves rather than all at once.

steps.title: Visit the DeepBook Claims Portal
steps.body: Go to the DeepBook claims portal . Read and accept the terms of use and privacy policy before moving on.

steps.title: Confirm You Have SUI for Gas
steps.body: Claiming is an on-chain transaction, so your wallet needs a small amount of SUI to cover the network fee. If you need some, you can buy SUI from Binance , or swap and bridge funds using the widget below.

steps.title: Connect Your Season 1 Wallet
steps.body: Bridge funds Swap and bridge across 30+ chains without leaving this page. Fast routes, low fees. Bridge now Opens an interactive bridge widget Open the bridge in a new tab Click “Connect Wallet” and link the same wallet you used to earn points during Season 1. Approve the connection request in your wallet. If you traded from more than one address, connect each separately to check for allocations.

steps.title: Review and Submit Your Claim
steps.body: Check the DEEP allocation shown, then submit the claim transaction and approve it in your wallet. Once it confirms, your DEEP appears in the connected wallet.

items.description: DeepBook’s main live campaign is the waitlist for its new trading app. Access opens in waves, and referring other traders moves you up the queue for earlier entry. Joining early and building referrals may position you for future rewards, though DeepBook has not confirmed a waitlist allocation.

items.tagline: There hasn’t been any news about an official airdrop. There is no confirmed $RITUAL token, ticker, or way to get it. Tha

steps.title: Join the Ritual Discord
steps.body: Go to Ritual’s Discord and complete onboarding. You’ll need a verified Discord account. The Discord is where roles are assigned and where testnet access is gated.

steps.title: Complete Community Quests
steps.body: Visit the Ritual quest portal and log in with your Discord account. Complete available tasks to earn XP and role upgrades. Current quest categories include: Social tasks Discord engagement and invites Pledge section submissions (if open — submit unique text when active)

steps.title: Earn and Upgrade Discord Roles
steps.body: You can move up in your role by being active on Discord. The team keeps track of roles like Ritualist, Zealot, Summoner, Radiant Ritualist, and Pledged to Synful. Higher roles give you priority access to the testnet. Keep an eye on channels and announcements for tasks that are specific to your role.

items.description: There hasn’t been any news about an official airdrop. There is no confirmed $RITUAL token, ticker, or way to get it. That being said, the project has active community programs like Discord role quests and ambassador activities that are similar to how projects that later rewarded contributors got people involved in the beginning.

steps.title: Claim Test ETH from the Faucet
steps.body: Open the Robinhood Chain Testnet Faucet , enter your wallet address, and request test ETH. You need it for gas and for trading on the testnet.

steps.title: Connect Your Wallet to Vibe Vibe
steps.body: Go to the Vibe Vibe testnet and connect your EVM wallet. If your wallet asks you to add or switch to Robinhood Chain Testnet, approve it.

steps.title: Create a Testnet Token
steps.body: Click the launch option and fill in the details: Token name and ticker Token image (required) A short description of the project Put some effort into it, because the team says quality launches count.

steps.title: Buy and Sell Testnet Tokens
steps.body: Trade tokens launched by other users. Buy early on the bonding curve and sell into strength, since high PnL is one of the listed eligibility criteria.

steps.title: Join the Telegram Raiding Channel
steps.body: Join the Vibe Vibe Telegram and take part in raids on X. You need a verified X account, and the top 250 raiders qualify for a free Vibe Vibers NFT.

steps.title: Apply for a Vibe Vibers Whitelist
steps.body: Follow the Vibe Vibers page for mint updates. Creators who make memes or other content can apply for collab spots when the form opens, with free mint whitelists awarded based on quality.

items.description: Vibe Vibe says 5% of its token supply is set aside for testnet participants. Traders with strong PnL, token creators, and active users are the groups named as eligible. The allocation is discretionary: the team can exclude sybil and wash-trading wallets, and testnet points or leaderboard positions do not guarantee a reward.

steps.title: Submit Your Testnet Points
steps.body: Visit the submission portal and sign in with the EVM wallet you registered Create or select a Canopy wallet to receive tokens The locked portion is already credited to your wallet and releases on its own schedule, so there is nothing further to claim, sign, or pay gas for.

items.tagline: The Yakkamon airdrop is confirmed and NFT focused. The top 5,000 trainers on the Season 0 points leaderboard receive Mon

steps.title: Sign Up at Yakkamon
steps.body: Create your account with an email address on the Yakkamon pre-registration page . No wallet is needed at this stage. Enter the referral code YAKKA-52UCFU during sign-up.

steps.title: Nurture Your Egg Daily
steps.body: Tap your egg three times each day for +6 points. Daily streaks add bonuses, and a missed day resets the streak.

steps.title: Connect Discord and X
steps.body: Link your Discord and X accounts for +10 points each. Helpful posts in the Discord earn extra points through community reactions, and the weekly share quest pays +20 points per week once X is connected.

steps.title: Link and Verify a Wallet
steps.body: Connect a wallet and sign a message to prove ownership for +10 points. A verified wallet is also required for the free mint whitelist, so complete this well before October 1, 2026.

steps.title: Refer Friends
steps.body: Each verified friend who joins earns you +30 points. Your first five referrals count instantly; after that, invitees must verify Discord and X and reach 100 points before the bonus lands. Multi-accounting gets filtered out on review.

steps.title: Mint the Free Monster NFT on October 1
steps.body: Join the free mint of 10,000 Monster NFTs on Ronin using your verified wallet. It costs nothing beyond a small gas fee, is limited to one mint per trainer, and minting adds points to your leaderboard total.

steps.title: Mint Your Yakkamon NFT
steps.body: Check which waves your Ronin wallet qualifies for on the whitelist checker Deposit 5 $FLOWER if you’re minting in Wave 2 or Wave 4 (see the $FLOWER deposit guide ) Connect your Ronin wallet to the Ronin Launchpad when your wave opens and mint, keeping some RON for gas

items.description: The Yakkamon airdrop is confirmed and NFT focused. The top 5,000 trainers on the Season 0 points leaderboard receive Monster NFTs when early access launches: ranks 1 to 1,000 get Legendary Monster NFTs and ranks 1,001 to 5,000 get Rare Monster NFTs. Distribution is automatic and based purely on points, never on sign-up order. The same leaderboard decides early access, with the top 100,000 trainers entering in waves.

items.description: Satsuma’s airdrop checker is now live ahead of the SUMA TGE on June 4, 2026, with 3,000,000 SUMA allocated to early supporters, liquidity providers, and community members.

items.name: Flop Labs
items.tagline: The airdrop is confirmed. Hayes has stated a large $FLOP distribution is planned for Q4 2026, ahead of the genesis block

steps.title: Follow Flop Labs on X
steps.body: Follow the official Flop Labs X account and turn on notifications. This is the only requirement the project has published for eligibility, and it is where testnet dates will land first.

steps.title: Follow Arthur Hayes for early terms
steps.body: Follow CryptoHayes and subscribe to his Substack. His essays have carried more detail than the project account, including the 20% testnet figure, and more are coming. Terms tend to surface there first.

steps.title: Apply for a network role
steps.body: Open the Flop website and submit the form matching what you can deliver. Three of the four roles are open: GPU provider or miner: for anyone with hardware that can run inference. Miners earn block rewards plus payment per job. No minimum specifications have been published, so treat any circulating hardware requirement as unverified. Validator: confirms miners completed their assigned work and stores agent memory. Suited to people comfortable running nodes. KOL or creator: the lowest barrier of the three. A few solid posts plus the form is the entry price, and Substack counts, which helps if your X account is weak. The fourth role, Agents, is the demand side: they spend $FLOP rather than earn it, so there is nothing to apply for.

steps.title: Start publishing $FLOP content now
steps.body: If you took the creator route, post before the program formally opens. There is no leaderboard yet, and if scoring ends up mindshare-based it will likely be applied retroactively. Stay on theme: decentralized inference, GPU economics, Hayes’ argument that the AI buildout is a debt problem rather than a technology one.

steps.title: Get ready for the Q4 testnet
steps.body: The 20% allocation is earned on the testnet, which has not opened. Hold off on configuring a wallet for a specific network, because Flop Labs has not named the chain. Watch the official account and be ready to onboard when it goes live.

items.description: The airdrop is confirmed. Hayes has stated a large $FLOP distribution is planned for Q4 2026, ahead of the genesis block in Q1 2027, though eligibility rules and snapshot dates are unpublished. His 19 August essay put roughly 20% of supply with testnet participants, released across ten years.

steps.body: Go to the Wick waitlist and connect your EVM wallet. Approve the connection request, and the page adds your wallet to the list.

steps.title: Share Wick on X
steps.body: Complete the X share task to post about Wick from your account. Follow Wick on X while you’re there, since the team posts its launch news there.

steps.title: Join the Wick Discord
steps.body: Join the Wick Discord to follow announcements and ask questions.

steps.title: Claim Your Referral Link
steps.body: Open the referral section on the waitlist page, enter a name, and claim your personal referral link. This option only unlocks after your wallet is registered in Step 1.

steps.title: Explore the Wick Docs
steps.body: Read through the Wick docs to learn how wAMM, wLIT, wLLP, and sWICK work. Knowing the products in advance helps you act quickly once deposits open on Lighter EVM.

items.description: Wick has not confirmed an airdrop, and no allocation, points system, or TGE date has been announced. The only official signal is the September 7, 2026 waitlist launch post, which says early users will be recognized.

steps.title: Visit the Worldie Early Access Page
steps.body: Go to the Worldie early access page and click “Join early.” Sign in with your X account or Google.

steps.title: Join the Worldie Discord
steps.body: Use the Discord icon on the early access page to join the official Worldie Discord. The +400 World Points bonus is added once you’re in the server.

steps.title: Connect Your X Account and Wallet
steps.body: Open the “Get your invite” panel and connect X (if you signed in with Google) along with a wallet. Connecting both locks your referral link. There is no deposit step.

steps.title: Claim Your Invite Link
steps.body: Claim your personal invite link from the same panel. Worldie ties the link to your name.

steps.title: Share Your Link
steps.body: Send the link to friends and communities that would use a social trading app. A referral only counts after the invited user signs up and connects both X and a wallet, so mention both requirements when you share it.

steps.title: Track Your Rank on the Leaderboard
steps.body: Click “See the board” to check your World Points and position. Global, Friends, This Week, and All Time tabs let you compare yourself against everyone or just your own network.

items.description: Worldie has not confirmed an airdrop, and the $WORLDIE token has not launched. The early access page invites users to “be early for $WORLDIE,” and the team says the token will launch on Worldie through Pons, with the announcement coming first on its official channels.

steps.title: Join the Blackboard Waitlist
steps.body: Go to the Blackboard waitlist page and sign up with a Google or X account. Your rank updates live, and higher ranked users reach Alpha sooner.

steps.title: Follow Blackboard and Post the Referral Tweet
steps.body: Link your X account in the waitlist task list, follow Blackboard , and then post the referral tweet the page generates. Blackboard verifies both before crediting the task, which is worth 60 points.

steps.title: Share Your Invite Link
steps.body: Copy the invite link from your waitlist dashboard. Every friend who joins through it adds 30 points to your score. Invite codes also circulate through partners and selected communities.

steps.title: Create Your Blackboard Account
steps.body: When access opens, sign in at the Blackboard terminal with Google, Apple or email, or connect a wallet you already use. Social login creates an embedded self-custodial wallet, so you hold the keys either way.

steps.title: Deposit USDC to Your Blackboard Wallet
steps.body: Open Deposit from the Portfolio screen, choose the asset and network, then send funds to the address shown. Picking the wrong network can lose the deposit permanently. Instant and free: USDC on Arbitrum, Polygon, HyperEVM or Solana Routed for a fee shown before you confirm: USDC on Ethereum, Base or BNB Chain Also accepted: USDT credited as USDC, $10 minimum You can buy USDC on Bybit and withdraw straight to Arbitrum , or shift what you already hold onto a supported network with the widget below. Bridge funds Swap and bridge across 30+ chains without leaving this page. Fast routes, low fees. Bridge now Opens an interactive bridge widget Open the bridge in a new tab

steps.title: Trade Perpetual Futures
steps.body: Open the Trade tab and pick a market. Volume lands on two protocols that each run their own reward programs, so one position builds history in more than one place.

steps.title: Invite Traders From Inside the Terminal
steps.body: Grab your referral code from My Page once you are trading. You earn 10% of the Blackboard fee on every trade your invitees make. Self-referral is banned and rebates can be clawed back.

items.description: Blackboard has not confirmed a token or an airdrop. What exists is Board Point, a rewards balance tied to trading activity, plus a live leaderboard and a referral program paying 10% of the Blackboard fee on invited users’ trades. Earning rates are still being finalized.

steps.body: Open MetaMask or another EVM wallet and add GIWA Sepolia, chain ID 91342.

steps.title: Claim GIWA Sepolia test ETH
steps.body: Request test ETH from the Lambda256 faucet linked on Ammora’s mission page. The liquidity mission has a 0.001 ETH minimum and gas on GIWA is negligible, so you need very little.

steps.body: Go to the Ammora waitlist , connect your wallet, sign the message and register an email. Every mission stays locked until this is done, and the wallet you use will be publicly tied to the leaderboard.

steps.body: Follow the official Ammora account from the X account you want credited, then return to the dashboard to verify for 100 AP.

steps.title: Retweet the pinned post
steps.body: Repost the pinned campaign post from the same X account for another 100 AP.

steps.title: Publish the daily X post

steps.body: Complete all five missions once during Launch Week, meaning joining, following, retweeting, posting and supplying. It is the largest single chunk of points available and it disappears when the window closes.

steps.title: Share your referral link

items.description: Ammora has no token and has not announced an airdrop, so this is a speculative play on a points program that may or may not convert into a distribution. What the team has committed to is beta access: the leaderboard guarantees seats to the top 1,000 point holders, plus 100 more drawn at random from everyone else.

steps.title: Create Your Acepyr Account
steps.body: Sign up at Acepyr with an email and password, entering referral code PW34SD3C2J during registration. Codes only count when applied at signup. Verify your email to activate the account.

steps.title: Accept the Legal Documents and Complete Onboarding
steps.body: First login walks you through the Terms of Service, Privacy Policy and Testnet Points Notice, then the onboarding survey. Those steps plus your first sign-in pay 300 testnet $ACEPYR.

steps.title: Link a Wallet You Control
steps.body: In Settings, link a wallet by signing a message; a pasted address does not qualify. One address links to one account permanently, and linking pays 500 testnet $ACEPYR.

steps.title: Join the Mainnet Waitlist
steps.body: The most productive click on the platform. Joining needs a proven wallet holding at least the current minimum, now $10, read live across Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum, Optimism, Polygon and BSC. Native coins and major stablecoins count, and nothing is sent to Acepyr, so balances you already hold for Base , Arbitrum or Optimism farming clear the check. Joining pays 1,000 testnet $ACEPYR, puts the first 10,000 qualifying accounts in line for $5 at launch, and activates whoever referred you. Short of the minimum? Pick up ETH or USDC on Bybit , then use the widget below to move it onto Base or another supported chain. Bridge funds Swap and bridge across 30+ chains without leaving this page. Fast routes, low fees. Bridge now Opens an interactive bridge widget Open the bridge in a new tab

steps.title: Trade the Live Up or Down Markets
steps.body: Take Up or Down on a five-minute window and let the price feed settle it. Three first-time achievements sit here: Open your first position: 250 testnet $ACEPYR Place your first limit order: 250 testnet $ACEPYR Close your first profitable position: 300 testnet $ACEPYR

steps.title: Enter the Weekly Tournament
steps.body: Entry is free and individual, with no ticket and no minimum balance. One settled trade that week makes you valid and earns a share of the 10,000 testnet $ACEPYR pool.

steps.title: Build a Sign-In Streak
steps.body: The streak pays at five rungs: 50 at two days, 100 at three, 300 at seven, 500 at fourteen and 1,000 at thirty. Each rung banks permanently.

steps.body: Open Profile, then Referrals. Codes reset every month and points do not carry over.

steps.title: Log In With Your X Account
steps.body: Go to the REP app and sign in with X. This becomes the anchor identity for your profile, and REP reads public metrics like follower quality to seed your first badges.

steps.title: Connect Your Wallets
steps.body: Open your profile and bind your wallets. REP supports roughly five addresses per account, EVM and others. Use the wallets with the deepest history, since an empty wallet produces no achievements. You only sign a message to prove ownership, with no approvals or transfers.

steps.title: Link Your Other Social Accounts
steps.body: Add Telegram, Farcaster, Discord, and any other supported platform from the profile page. Each one widens the pool of achievements you qualify for.

steps.title: Claim Your Achievements
steps.body: Open the achievements list and claim every badge you qualify for. Values range from a few hundred REP points for social milestones up to 3,000 for top-percentile DeFi activity. Some claims charge a small on-chain fee, so keep a little of the relevant gas token in your connected wallet. You can buy it on Bybit and withdraw it directly, or move assets you already hold with the widget below to bridge or swap onto the chain you need. Bridge funds Swap and bridge across 30+ chains without leaving this page. Fast routes, low fees. Bridge now Opens an interactive bridge widget Open the bridge in a new tab

steps.title: Set Your Remoji Rank
steps.body: Ranks run across seven tiers, from pilgrim at the bottom to the top 0.5% band. Once your badges are claimed, set the rank emoji on your REP profile and on Telegram, where it acts as the signal other users read before connecting with you.

steps.title: Browse Matches and Join Rooms
steps.body: Open the Matches section to see communities your reputation qualifies you for. Some rooms ask for an email address. Join the ones relevant to your activity rather than every room on the list.

steps.title: Share Your Social Graph Invite Link
steps.body: Grab your personal invite link from the Social Graph section and share it. Invites are weighted by who accepts them, so a handful of active wallets beats a long list of empty ones.

items.description: REP has not announced a token or an airdrop. What exists is a live points system where achievements and connections award REP points that feed a public ranking.

items.name: Vangrid
items.tagline: Vangrid has not confirmed an airdrop. A token is planned for later in 2026, but no allocation, snapshot, or eligibility

steps.title: Install the Vangrid App
steps.body: Download the Vangrid App on Android, or open the browser capture tool if you are on iOS. Allow camera and location access, since captures without location data cannot be verified.

steps.title: Record a Capture That Meets the Spec
steps.body: Film a location a robot would realistically need to cross. Vangrid accepts: Sidewalks and pedestrian paths Stairs and stairwells Alleys and service lanes Public squares and plazas Skip roads, crowds of people, and private indoor spaces. Recording requirements: Hold the phone vertically at chest level, using both hands Walk at a steady pace and pan smoothly from side to side Record 30 to 60 seconds in daylight

steps.title: Enter an Invite Code and Upload
steps.body: Uploads are gated behind an invite code. Enter GRID-01 before uploading. Uploading daily adds a 50-point bonus, with further bonuses at 5, 10, and 50 total videos.

steps.title: Connect Your Wallet to the Loyalty Hub
steps.body: Open the Vangrid Loyalty Hub and connect an EVM wallet. Your first login credits PTC on its own.

steps.title: Complete Loyalty Hub Quests
steps.body: Work through the quest list: follow Vangrid on X, join the Discord, connect LinkedIn, engage with posts, and publish weekly X posts. Reach Discord through the Hub quest link rather than a forwarded invite. No legitimate verification asks you to sign a wallet transaction, so close any page that does.

steps.title: Unlock Grid Operator Status
steps.body: Follow Vangrid on X, join the Discord, and submit one in-app video to earn the Grid Operator role and badge, which applies a 1.5x multiplier to your PTC.

steps.title: Submit to Funded Bounties
steps.body: Browse open requests at the Vangrid bounty portal. These are location-specific asks from buyers, and selected submissions pay USDC on Base. Browsing requires no invite code.

steps.title: Refer Other Contributors
steps.body: Share your Hub referral link. You earn 10% of the PTC your referrals generate, and each new user who joins through a link starts with a 50 PTC bonus.

items.description: Vangrid has not confirmed an airdrop. A token is planned for later in 2026, but no allocation, snapshot, or eligibility rule has been published, which makes this a potential future airdrop rather than a scheduled one.

items.name: Amadeus Protocol
items.tagline: Amadeus has not confirmed a token airdrop. What exists today is PRIME Points, an active rewards program tied to AMA Hub

steps.title: Connect a Wallet
steps.body: Open the AMA Hub quests page and connect an EVM wallet such as MetaMask, Rabby, or Trust. This is the address your PRIME Points are paid to.

steps.title: Create Your Amadeus Wallet
steps.body: Install the Amadeus Wallet browser extension and set it up. This wallet holds $AMA and runs your sealed agents, and creating it is one of the larger one-off point rewards in the season.

steps.title: Link Both Wallets
steps.body: Sign once from each wallet to connect them. The link tells the season that your chain address and Amadeus account belong to the same person, and quests stay locked until both are added.

steps.title: Complete the Daily Check-In
steps.body: Return each day and claim the check-in on the quests page. Daily points reset and do not carry over, so steady visits matter more than any single session.

steps.title: Build and Deploy an Agent
steps.body: Create an agent on AMA Hub and put it to work. These build quests are read directly from the chain, so nothing needs to be submitted. To earn across more of them: Add a skill to your agent so it can act Run an agent trade or swap on the network Claim a username for your account

steps.title: Finish the Social Quests
steps.body: Complete the social tasks, which the campaign verifies within a few minutes: Follow Amadeus on X Join the Amadeus Discord Engage with the pinned launch post Record a short video explainer for the largest social reward

steps.title: Invite Referrals
steps.body: Share your referral link from the quests page. You earn 20% of the PRIME Points your invitees collect, which compounds as they stay active.

items.description: Amadeus has not confirmed a token airdrop. What exists today is PRIME Points, an active rewards program tied to AMA Hub Season 01. Points are minted on the Amadeus chain as you complete quests, and secondary coverage has linked them to a possible future $AMA distribution, though the team has not committed to a conversion. Treat any allocation as speculative for now.
